value_blindness: committed before any KLF12 value of any candidate reference was read; no value-derived artifact exists
reason: independent review (stand-in reviewer, report 20260925T091846Z-2914497fee99): the frozen S5 rule accepted a donor with only 80 of 99 null replicates fitted, which bounds the Monte Carlo p at 1/81 = 0.0123, not the stated 0.01

derivation.per_donor_criteria.S5.was: Monte Carlo test against a stateless Poisson null at the donor's own depths and detection fraction with its own decontX shrinkage ratios: at least 80 of 99 replicates fitted and the observed Ashman's D strictly above every fitted null replicate's (p <= 0.01)
derivation.per_donor_criteria.S5.now: Monte Carlo test against a stateless Poisson null at the donor's own depths and detection fraction with its own decontX shrinkage ratios: an unfitted null replicate counts as one the observed separation did not beat, p = (1 + replicates at or above the observed Ashman's D + unfitted replicates) / (1 + 99), and S5 passes iff p <= 0.01, i.e. all 99 replicates fitted and the observed D strictly above every one

changes.guard: the guard accepts numbered amendments like this one, each its own commit, before any value-derived work; the latest amendment's pins govern

direction: stricter: every donor that passes the amended S5 also passed the original
unchanged: every other rule of the pre-registration

candidate_selection.rule: qualification.select(inventory, min_reference_donors=3): metadata-only D1/D2/D5/D8 qualification, then the D7 order
candidate_selection.fallthrough: a VALUE-BLIND failure of the selected candidate (retrieval checksum, pipeline reproduction, reprocessing, donor-label join, fewer than min_reference_donors donors with cells) passes to the next candidate in the frozen order; a VALUE-AWARE failure (derive() returns NO_STABLE_SEPARATION) never does, because trying candidates until one separates would select a reference by its KLF12 distribution
candidate_selection.next_candidates: none: C03 is the only metadata-qualified candidate

rr14_citations.evidence_citation: E-MTAB-10283 (the reference dataset the state separation is measured in), evidence_kind reference_state_separation
rr14_citations.comparability_evidence: doi:10.5281/zenodo.17412607 (the ADOC pipeline code and lock file) together with the committed stack-identification result
rr14_citations.threshold_derivation: NONE VALID: the derivation is this pre-registration's own procedure and has no DOI or accession. Under the owner's citation rule no DOI is minted and no dataset is cited as a method; unless the owner approves an RR14 citation-schema adjustment before the definition-freeze commit, the verdict is at most BLOCKED_OWNER_DECISION
